summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py, which handles all eight depot formats and the shared export conventions (gzip, BOMs and charsets, mid-file headers and directives, per-row units, layout switches). I ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/summary.json, and tools/check_summary.py reports every value matches the reference. Behaviour on other exports is untested beyond the documented rules.
